heading.en: What does it take to communicate?

hook.en: When you send a WhatsApp message, there is you, your friend, the message, the mobile network, and a set of rules both phones follow. Remove any one and the message does not arrive.

objectives.en: List the five components of data communication
Define bandwidth and data transfer rate

narration.en: When you send a WhatsApp message, there is you, your friend, the message, the mobile network, and a set of rules both phones follow. Remove any one and the message does not arrive.
narration.kn: ನೀವು ವಾಟ್ಸ್‌ಆಪ್ ಸಂದೇಶ ಕಳುಹಿಸಿದಾಗ ನೀವು, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತ, ಸಂದೇಶ, ಮೊಬೈಲ್ ಜಾಲ ಮತ್ತು ಎರಡೂ ಫೋನ್‌ಗಳು ಪಾಲಿಸುವ ನಿಯಮಗಳು ಇರುತ್ತವೆ. ಯಾವುದೊಂದು ಇಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೂ ಸಂದೇಶ ತಲುಪುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

body.en: Data communication is the exchange of data between two or more networked devices. It has five components: the sender (sends the message), the receiver (receives it), the message (text, audio, video, image, numbers), the communication medium (the path: wired or wireless), and protocols (the agreed rules for communication).

narration.en: Every data communication has a sender, a receiver, a message, a medium and protocols, which are the rules both sides follow.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಸಂವಹನದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಳುಹಿಸುವವರು, ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸುವವರು, ಸಂದೇಶ, ಮಾಧ್ಯಮ ಮತ್ತು ಶಿಷ್ಟಾಚಾರಗಳು ಇರುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: Bandwidth is the range of frequencies a channel can carry: the difference between the highest and lowest frequencies, measured in hertz (Hz). Higher bandwidth means more data can be carried. Data transfer rate (bit rate) is the number of bits sent per second, measured in bps, Kbps, Mbps, Gbps and Tbps; the textbook takes 1 Kbps = $2^{10}$ bps. Remember 1 byte = 8 bits.

points.en: Data rate in bps, Kbps, Mbps, Gbps

narration.en: Bandwidth is the frequency range of a channel, in hertz. Data transfer rate is bits per second. Remember one byte is eight bits.
